sbar.situation: Recovery was not confirmed: the incident commander gave up before the bank system was shown to be healthy. Clearing item 90 is set aside and waiting for the operations team.
sbar.background: The scheduler had changed the gateway setting balance_cache_ttl_s from 0.5 to 600 seconds. A reconciliation session was holding a lock on the ledger.
sbar.assessment: The incident commander did each step itself: it released the ledger lock by ending the reconciliation session, and it restored the gateway balance_cache_ttl_s to 0.5. It then quarantined clearing item 90 and restarted clearing; all four actions completed, but no recovery was confirmed.
sbar.recommendation: Check now whether the ledger, gateway and clearing are healthy, and find out why the scheduler changed balance_cache_ttl_s so it does not happen again. The operations team has been asked (soon priority) to review clearing item 90: either repair and resubmit it, or close it with its customer, and check for any money or balance effects from the 600-second balance cache.
